Markets.title: Two years on, Indian equities remain stuck in a grind
Markets.summary: Indian equities have experienced a challenging market phase with mixed returns since September 2024, featuring significant declines in the Nifty and Sensex alongside better performance in small and mid-cap stocks. Despite these difficulties, valuation froth has decreased to create potential buying opportunities, though global investors remain hesitant to commit funds.

Markets.title: Rupee's likely to slip despite RBI push for stability
Markets.summary: Economists predict the Indian rupee will fall to 96-97 per dollar by the end of fiscal year 2027 due to persistent asset outflows and high crude oil prices. Despite the Reserve Bank of India's efforts to ensure stability, ongoing foreign exchange pressures are expected to drive the depreciation.

Markets.title: Insurance mis-selling is arising because upfront commissions are too high: Ajay Seth, Chairman, IRDAI
Markets.summary: IRDAI Chairman Ajay Seth stated that high upfront commissions are driving the mis-selling of insurance products. He emphasized that cost efficiencies must be passed on to customers through better returns, improved claim ratios, and lower premiums.

Markets.title: Father time always wins! What Warren Buffett’s 4-word farewell message means
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett has officially stepped down from Berkshire Hathaway, handing leadership over to his son, Howard Buffett. While reflecting on aging, Buffett also expressed concern about growing speculative trends in the current stock market.

Markets.title: Trans ACNR Solutions, 8 others file IPO papers with Sebi
Markets.summary: Trans ACNR Solutions and eight other companies have filed initial public offering papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) to raise capital. Among them, Maharashtra Oil Extractions aims to raise up to Rs 370 crore through new shares and an offer for sale.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian stock benchmarks Sensex and Nifty closed higher on Friday at 73,896 and 23,140.50, respectively. Strong domestic liquidity kept the Nifty above 23,000, while high crude prices and foreign outflows are expected to limit near-term market gains.

Geo-Political.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC gained rare access to a front-line conflict zone in Yemen. Reporters traveled with pro-government soldiers as they battled Houthi forces for control of the city.

Geo-Political.title: Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
Geo-Political.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić has resigned following months of prolonged protests over government corruption allegations. His departure has paved the way for early elections in the country.

Geo-Political.title: Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
Geo-Political.summary: An avalanche struck a Himalayan climbing group preparing to scale the Himlung Himal peak. Rescuers found two bodies and are searching for at least 10 missing Nepalese guides.

Geo-Political.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
Geo-Political.summary: Two separate mass shootings in South Africa resulted in the deaths of 27 people within hours of each other. These violent incidents occurred as the nation continues to battle high rates of gang-related armed violence.

Geo-Political.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
Geo-Political.summary: Four people died in a helicopter crash near Montreal. Quebec provincial police stated that the victims have not yet been identified.

Geo-Political.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
Geo-Political.summary: Venezuela has released dozens of political prisoners following long-term detention. The releases occurred days after the nation's interim leader met with the U.S. president amid growing election calls.

Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 1, major appliance and consumer electronics manufacturers will raise prices by 5% to 8%. This price increase affects popular festive season purchases, including air conditioners, LED TVs, and washing machines.

Data & Insights.title: Sitharaman on India’s 10%+ growth potential: Startups and technology can drive next phase
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that startups and technology can help India achieve over 10% economic growth. She noted that reaching this higher growth level requires significant effort from all sections of society to advance national development goals.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $14.9 billion in a single week, according to the Reserve Bank of India. The decline was primarily driven by a drop in foreign currency assets, which make up the largest component of the reserves.

Data & Insights.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: According to the RBI Bulletin, India's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite ongoing global risks. This economic strength is supported by strong Q1 growth, a five-year high in net FDI, robust exports and remittances, and $765.9 billion in foreign exchange reserves.

Data & Insights.title: CEA flags US friction, energy shocks, and missing AI play as India’s key near-term risks
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran warned that India faces near-term risks from trade coercion, weaponized supply chains, and rising US bond yields. These global challenges require India to adopt a costlier hedging strategy and a new economic playbook.

Data & Insights.title: India’s growth outlook strengthens as economists see resilient incomes, stable policy: WEF
Data & Insights.summary: Seventy-four percent of economists surveyed by the World Economic Forum expect India to experience strong economic growth over the next year. This improved outlook is driven by strong domestic demand and steady policy expectations.

India.title: Amritpal Singh's Waris Punjab De A New Challenge For Akali Dal Ahead Of Polls

India.title: Students Deny 'Rape' In Video Released By Punjab's Lovely Professional University, Then Call It Scripted
India.summary: Students at Lovely Professional University vandalized their campus and set fires during protests over unverified claims that a female student had been sexually assaulted and died by suicide. In a subsequently released video, the students denied the rape allegations and stated that the controversy was scripted.

India.title: Suvendu Adhikari Says Bengal Will Protect Cows, Jail People Who Insult Monks
India.summary: At a Bhagavad Gita event in Kolkata, West Bengal opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari stated that the state will protect cows and imprison those who insult monks. He also assured attendees that there is nothing to fear when practicing or promoting their faith.

India.title: In Rajasthan Civic Polls, BJP Scoops Up 204 Boards, Congress Trails With 96
India.summary: The BJP won 204 urban local body boards in the Rajasthan civic polls, while the Congress trailed with 96. The BJP notably secured seven out of nine boards in the tribal-dominated districts of Banswara, Dungarpur, and Pratapgarh.
